reader.requirement: A START on a relative file must succeed only when the file is open in the input or I-O mode; when it is not open (never opened, closed, after a failed OPEN) or open OUTPUT or EXTEND, the START is unsuccessful with I-O status 47 (VIII.1.3.4), which is not the invalid key condition, so the INVALID KEY phrase does not run and the USE procedure does.

edition-consulted.switches: ConstructRegistry StartFirstLast2002 and StartReverseOperators2002: START FIRST/LAST and LESS/<= operators refused at 85 with COBOL0900; the KEY = > NOT< >= form passes
FileSharingFacility off at 85; the open-mode guard is the same code

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectBehavior over RelativeConnector.cs#Start, FileConnector.cs#StartOpenModeGuard, FileRegistry.cs#StartRelative and KeyedIoEmitter.cs#EmitStart: none at runtime; compile-time gates in VersionConformancePass only.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: only the phrases a later edition added (FIRST/LAST, reverse operators) are refused at 85; the open-mode rule and its 47 are identical
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf26_04 covers OUTPUT, closed, INPUT and I-O in dynamic access; not EXTEND (sequential access only in 85), never opened, after a failed OPEN, or that INVALID KEY does not run on 47

probes.printed: USE 47 NEVER 47 / USE 47 OUT 47 / OPEN-EXT 00 / USE 47 EXT 47 / EXT-WRITE 00 0003 / USE 47 CLOSED 47 / USE-N 35 OPEN-N 35 / USE-N 47 AFTER-FAILED-OPEN 47 / IN OK 00 / IN-NEXT 0002 REC-02 / IO INV 23 / IO3 OK 00 / IO-NEXT 0003 REC-03
probes.expected: 47 with the USE procedure and neither INVALID KEY nor NOT INVALID KEY phrase for never-open, OUTPUT, EXTEND (implied EQUAL, no KEY phrase), closed, after a failed OPEN; the EXTEND WRITE after the failed START still appends record 3; INPUT and I-O succeed and position

probes.printed: COBOL0900 START FIRST/LAST requires COBOL-2002; COBOL0900 a reverse-search START KEY operator (LESS ...) requires COBOL-2002 (twice: LESS THAN, <=)

reader.notes: StartOpenModeGuard answers 47 for not open or OUTPUT/EXTEND, and Start returns it through Unsuccessful (position invalidated). st1a at --std 2023 prints the identical lines.

refuter.evidence: Probe refute-1985-136/s1b.cob at --std 85 (runs/s1b-001): the boundary the reader did not try, a file that IS open INPUT but is an absent OPTIONAL file -> 'OPEN-OA 05', START is the invalid key 23 of GR6 ('OA INV 23'), not 47; OPTIONAL absent opened I-O (created, 05), START >= -> 'OB INV 23'; CLOSE WITH LOCK then START -> 'USE 47 / AFTER-LOCK 47' with neither INVALID KEY nor NOT INVALID KEY run.
